title: Target Knockdown
description: Choose a safe target and see how many accurate rolls, hand passes or kicks you can make.
target: Hit the target 10 times from 20 attempts

title: Around the Body
description: Move a ball around your waist, knees and legs without dropping it.
target: Complete 5 full circuits in each direction

title: Balance Explorer
description: Balance a beanbag or rolled-up sock while moving slowly around a safe space.
target: Complete 3 one-minute rounds using 3 different body parts

title: Passing Streak
description: Hand pass or kick pass with a partner, or use a safe wall, and try to build your longest accurate streak.
target: Complete 20 accurate passes with no more than 3 misses

title: Follow My Moves
description: Ask someone to lead four movements, then copy each one as closely as you can.

title: Clap and Catch
description: Throw a soft ball or rolled-up sock upwards, clap once, and catch it safely.
target: Complete 20 catches, then try 10 with two claps
